mapper.sql: a.bbs30_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , a.bbs30_company_id AS company_id , a.bbs30_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_nm , a.bbs30_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id , a.bbs30_seq AS seq , a.bbs30_note AS note , a.bbs30_type_cd AS type_cd , (COALESCE(a.bbs30_use_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS use_yn , (COALESCE(a.bbs30_public_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS public_yn
mapper.select: SELECT , CASE WHEN a.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' THEN NULL ELSE parent.bbs30_class_tree_nm END AS parent_tree_nm , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs31_content WHERE bbs31_class_tree_id = a.bbs30_class_tree_id AND ( (COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'false') OR (COALESCE(bbs31_hide_yn,'false') = 'true' AND bbs31_person_id = #{personId}) ) ) AS count FROM bbs30_class_tree a INNER JOIN bbs30_class_tree parent ON a.bbs30_parent_tree_id = parent.bbs30_class_tree_id AND parent.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' WHERE parent.bbs30_use_yn = 'true' AND a.bbs30_use_yn = 'true' AND a.bbs30_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.bbs30_type_cd = #{typeCode} AND ( a.bbs30_public_yn = 'true' OR ( a.bbs30_public_yn = 'false' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bbs33_role WHERE bbs33_class_tree_id = a.bbs30_class_tree_id AND ( (bbs33_role_cd = 'P' AND bbs33_person_id = #{personId}) OR (bbs33_role_cd = 'O' AND bbs33_org_code_id = #{orgId}) ) ) ) ) ORDER BY a.bbs30_seq, a.bbs30_class_tree_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT , CASE WHEN a.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' THEN NULL ELSE parent.bbs30_class_tree_nm END AS parent_tree_nm , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs31_content WHERE bbs31_class_tree_id = a.bbs30_class_tree_id ) AS count FROM bbs30_class_tree a LEFT OUTER JOIN bbs30_class_tree parent ON a.bbs30_parent_tree_id = parent.bbs30_class_tree_id AND parent.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' WHERE a.bbs30_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.bbs30_type_cd = #{typeCode} ORDER BY a.bbs30_seq, a.bbs30_class_tree_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT , CASE WHEN a.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' THEN NULL ELSE parent.bbs30_class_tree_nm END AS parent_tree_nm , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs31_content WHERE bbs31_class_tree_id = a.bbs30_class_tree_id ) AS count FROM bbs30_class_tree a LEFT JOIN bbs30_class_tree parent ON a.bbs30_parent_tree_id = parent.bbs30_class_tree_id AND parent.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' WHERE a.bbs30_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.bbs30_type_cd = #{typeCode} AND a.bbs30_parent_tree_id = #{parentTreeId} ORDER BY a.bbs30_seq, a.bbs30_class_tree_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT , CASE WHEN a.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' THEN NULL ELSE parent.bbs30_class_tree_nm END AS parent_tree_nm , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs31_content WHERE bbs31_class_tree_id = a.bbs30_class_tree_id ) AS count FROM bbs30_class_tree a LEFT JOIN bbs30_class_tree parent ON a.bbs30_parent_tree_id = parent.bbs30_class_tree_id AND parent.bbs30_type_cd = 'C' WHERE a.bbs30_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND a.bbs30_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs30_class_tree (bbs30_class_tree_id, bbs30_company_id, bbs30_class_tree_nm, bbs30_parent_tree_id, bbs30_seq, bbs30_type_cd, bbs30_use_yn, bbs30_public_yn) VALUES (#{classTreeId}, #{companyId}, #{r.classTreeNm}, #{r.parentTreeId}, #{r.seq}, #{r.typeCd}, CASE WHEN #{r.useYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, CASE WHEN #{r.publicYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END)
